title: 4 Things You're Saying Every Day at Work That Are KILLING Your Career
description:
Stop saying these 4 things at work — HR already knows, and it's costing you more than you think. 
Most people don't realize what they say every single day at work is quietly destroying their reputation. As someone who's worked in HR, I'm pulling back the curtain on the exact phrases that make leadership take you less seriously — and what to say instead.
In this video:
 The 4 phrases that scream "I'm not leadership material"
 What HR and your manager actually think when they hear them
 Exactly what to say instead to protect your reputation
This is the kind of professional communication advice nobody teaches you — but everyone in the office already knows.
 Want the full no-BS playbook for navigating your career?
